surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the alternating pulses of Mn2(CO)10 and O3, leading to the formation of Mn2O3 and Mn3O4 thin films. The process is self-limiting, with the surface reactions saturating after a certain pulse length, ensuring uniform film growth.
